carve.title: Carve
carve.description: Content-aware image resizing. Drag an edge and the picture shrinks by removing its least interesting paths, so subjects stay intact. Paint over an object and delete it.

foldwork.title: Foldwork
foldwork.description: A tiny paper studio. Size an envelope, add a name and a message, print the template and fold it into something real.

genesis-universe.title: Genesis
genesis-universe.description: Type anything and it becomes a universe. The same words always produce the same universe, on any machine.

kaleido.title: Kaleido
kaleido.description: Draw once, see it eight times. Every stroke mirrors around the centre into a mandala.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: Your money on one page, offline. Add an entry and the totals, chart and list update at once. Nothing leaves the browser.

meadowsong.title: Meadowsong
meadowsong.description: A wind-chime meadow you play by gliding your cursor through it.

position.title: Position
position.description: Press or fold — nothing in between. Six crude signals decide whether you have position in a deal, so there is nothing to interpret in the moment.

reckon.title: Reckon
reckon.description: A notepad that does math. Write naturally; numbers, units, dates and variables compute in the margin.

ripple.title: Ripple
ripple.description: A wave tank you can draw in. Walls reflect, glass refracts, and the whole wave equation is ten lines of code.

sonogram.title: Sonogram
sonogram.description: Draw a picture; hear it. The canvas is a spectrogram — left to right is time, bottom to top is pitch.

sprout-garden.title: Sprout
sprout-garden.description: A tiny garden you grow by clicking. Every plant is different; rain makes them grow faster.

stillpoint.title: Stillpoint
stillpoint.description: A little space to focus. Plant a star, shape a soundscape, make room for one thing.

tradeoff.title: Tradeoff
tradeoff.description: Make room for what matters. Rate your options, weigh your priorities, and see the smallest shift that would change your mind.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Projected income and expenses on one page, offline. Enter anything weekly, monthly or yearly and it normalizes to a monthly view.

crosslight.title: Crosslight
crosslight.description: A mirror puzzle. Turn the mirrors so every beam reaches its receiver — a small game that rewards a second look.

hilbert.title: Hilbert
hilbert.description: See the shape of any file. Every byte is laid along a Hilbert curve, so headers, text, compressed streams and padding each get their own texture.

labelmaker.title: Label sheets
labelmaker.description: Paste a list of names, pick a label size and paper, and print a sheet where every name is set as large as it fits.

tessera.title: Tessera
tessera.description: An Escher-style tiling editor. Shape one tile and the plane re-tiles itself with no gaps or overlaps.

chroma-desk.title: Chroma Desk
chroma-desk.description: A small studio for everyday color. Drop a photo, pull a palette out of it, then edit and export the swatches.

dayblock.title: Dayblock
dayblock.description: A time-block day planner. Drag on the timeline to carve out your day; overlaps are allowed and the totals just add up.

pantry-clock.title: Pantry Clock
pantry-clock.description: What's expiring first? Track what's in the fridge, freezer and pantry and tap an item to use it up before it becomes waste.

aether.title: Aether
aether.description: A cosmic particle weaver. Move the mouse to weave, click to plant a star, scroll to change the force; attract, orbit, chaos and paint modes.

pulseforge.title: PulseForge
pulseforge.description: An offline step sequencer. Eight tracks from kick to pad, click steps to toggle notes, tempo and randomize on the keyboard. Pure Web Audio.

cosmic-breath.title: Cosmic Breath
cosmic-breath.description: A slow particle field that breathes. Click to begin, move the cursor to bend its gravity, and let it set your pace.

chromawave.title: ChromaWave
chromawave.description: A synthesizer in the browser. Play the keys A to K, pick a waveform, turn the filter and delay knobs, and watch the waveform draw itself as it sounds.

orrery-calude.title: Orrery
orrery-calude.description: The solar system from above and the sky overhead, computed from orbital elements. Scrub time forward or back, pick a city, and click any body for its position, phase and rise and set times.

tidytext.title: Tidy Text
tidytext.description: Paste messy copied text and clean copy appears beside it. Toggle the rules: join wrapped lines, collapse blanks, fix double spaces, straighten quotes. Copy or download the result.

turtleloom.title: TurtleLoom
turtleloom.description: Turtle graphics with live sliders. Drag repeats, sides, turn step and hue and the pattern redraws as you go; edit the generated commands to go further, then save a PNG.

backplan.title: Backplan
backplan.description: Plan backward from a deadline. Set the finish time, list the steps with their minutes and prerequisites, and it works out the latest you can start and which steps have no slack.

meeting-meter.title: Meeting Meter
meeting-meter.description: Set attendees, hourly cost and planned length with three sliders, then start the timer and watch the running cost of the meeting climb by the second. Presets for standups and all-hands; save or reload the setup as JSON.

pipeline.title: KanbanFlow
pipeline.description: A deal pipeline board. Drag cards between Lead, Contacted, Proposal, Negotiation and Won; each deal carries a value and win probability, and the bar on top keeps total, weighted forecast and won value current. Save and reopen the board as JSON.

revision-room.title: Revision Room
revision-room.description: Paste a before and after draft and compare them: a word-level redline shows what was removed and added, with counts and next/previous jumps between changes. Swap drafts, copy the notes, or save the session as JSON.

veil.title: Veil
veil.description: Paste text with secrets or personal details in it, and every key, token, card number, email, IP, phone and name you list is swapped for a consistent placeholder so you can share it safely. Paste the reply back and Restore puts the originals in. Toggle categories with a click; save the session as JSON.

crux.title: Crux
crux.description: Type a project plan one task per line with optimistic-likely-pessimistic durations and dependencies, and it draws the Gantt chart, marks the critical path, and simulates the schedule thousands of times to show how likely each finish date really is. Tap a task for its float and risk; save or reopen plans as JSON.

dealforge.title: DealForge
dealforge.description: A sales pipeline board: drag deal cards between stages from lead to closed, click one to edit its value, probability, close date and next action, and watch the total and probability-weighted forecast update. Search filters the board; save or open the pipeline as JSON.

prism.title: Prism
prism.description: Paste any SQL and it parses it in the browser and shows the query's shape from seven angles: a dataflow diagram, join fan-out analysis, WHERE and CASE logic as trees, execution steps in order, column lineage, lint findings with one-click fixes, and a clause outline. Format or transform the query, then save the session as JSON.

logglass.title: Logglass
logglass.description: Paste or open an application log and it parses each line's level, timestamp and message, counts severities, maps where the noise clusters along the file, and groups recurring messages into patterns. Filter by level, text or region, pin the useful lines, add notes, and copy a brief for a handoff; save or reopen the investigation as JSON.

sieve.title: Sieve
sieve.description: Paste raw log lines in any format and it clusters them into message templates with the variable parts marked as slots, so thousands of lines collapse to a short list you can filter by level and sort by frequency. Drag across the timeline to see which templates spike or first appear in that window; tap one for its slot values, sample lines and a ready-made regex; export templates as CSV.

canvasforge.title: CanvasForge
canvasforge.description: A Business Model Canvas you fill in block by block. Add, edit and remove items across the nine blocks, watch the completeness score climb, and it writes a one-paragraph pitch from your segments, value propositions and revenue streams. Save and reopen as JSON.

rail.title: Rail
rail.description: Type a regular expression and it draws it as a railroad diagram you can read left to right. Paste test text to see every match highlighted, tap any box in the diagram to see which characters that part captured, read a plain-English breakdown, and preview a replacement live.

docuforge.title: DocuForge
docuforge.description: Lay out a one-page document on a canvas: drag text blocks into place, edit their text and size, fill in template variables like client, invoice number and total that substitute into any block that references them, then print it to PDF. Save the layout as JSON.

launchstamp.title: Launchstamp
launchstamp.description: Enter one destination URL and a campaign name, add a placement for each place the link will appear (newsletter, social post, partner email), and it builds the UTM-tagged URL for every placement, shows the anatomy of each, flags two placements that would produce the same link, and copies or exports the set as a launch sheet.

next-touch.title: Next Touch
next-touch.description: A small follow-up desk: add the people you want to stay in touch with, give each a next action and a date, and it sorts them into due, later and undated. After you talk to someone, log the touch with a note and pick the next step; the history stays with that person. Save and reopen as JSON.

outline-builder.title: Outline Builder
outline-builder.description: Pick a template (consulting proposal, statement of work or project brief), tick sections on or off, rename and reorder them or add your own, and it writes a numbered outline in a live preview you can copy or download as Markdown, text or JSON.

phish-spotter.title: Phish Spotter
phish-spotter.description: A deck of fourteen made-up emails, texts and chat messages. Swipe or press a button to call each one phish or legit, and after every verdict it tells you the tells you should have spotted (lookalike domains, urgency, odd requests) and keeps your score and streak.

flowforge.title: FlowForge
flowforge.description: A process mapper. Drop in start, task, decision and end nodes, drag them around, connect them with arrows and save the flowchart as a file you can reopen.

folio.title: Folio
folio.description: Write Markdown on the left and it is laid out as real pages on the right, with a cover, a table of contents, running headers and page numbers. Print to PDF exactly as shown.

campaign-link-builder.title: Campaign Link Builder
campaign-link-builder.description: Type a page URL, pick the source, medium and campaign, and a tracked UTM link builds itself as you type. Copy it, or save the ones you actually send.

draftloom.title: Draftloom
draftloom.description: Write a template with named slots like {{client_name}}, fill each detail once and every matching slot updates together. Export the finished text or save the template.

tranche.title: Tranche
tranche.description: A cap table exit waterfall. Enter the share classes with their preferences, caps and participation, then drag the exit value and see who gets paid what, where the kinks are and when a series converts to common.

deploy-board.title: Deploy Board
deploy-board.description: A release tracker board. Add a service, version, owner and risk level, then drag each card from backlog through staging and deploying to live; the board stays in the browser and can be saved to a file.

keyline.title: Keyline
keyline.description: A role-based permission workbench. Pick a role and an ability and it traces whether access is granted directly or inherited and from where, previews who loses access if you revoke a grant, and exports the whole model as a plain-text report.

loadmaster.title: LoadMaster
loadmaster.description: A load-test simulator. Set concurrent workers, base latency, jitter and an injected failure rate, hit start and watch throughput, p95 latency and the status-code mix move in real time. Nothing leaves the browser.

dibs.title: Dibs
dibs.description: Multi-touch attribution for a path report. Paste the touch paths from your analytics export with converted and non-converted counts, and it runs seven models over the same data — last, first, linear, position, decay, Markov removal effect and exact Shapley — and shows where they disagree about which channels open, assist and close.

common-hour.title: Common Hour
common-hour.description: Find a meeting time that fits everyone's working day. Add up to six people with their time zones, work windows and weekdays, then slide the start across the day and watch the local clocks line up; it marks the starts that fit all of them, jumps to the best overlap, and copies or exports the proposal with every local time.

contrast-checker.title: Contrast Checker
contrast-checker.description: Pick a text colour and a background colour and see the WCAG contrast ratio and which levels it passes, with a live preview at body, button and small-print sizes. One tap nudges the text colour until it reaches AA or AAA, and pairs that pass can be saved and moved between machines as JSON.

linework.title: Linework
linework.description: A reusable recipe for cleaning up lists. Paste a list, one item per line, then stack up to eight steps — trim, drop blanks, dedupe, replace, prefix or suffix, sort, keep or exclude matches, number — and inspect the rows at any stage before copying or exporting the final result. The source stays intact and the recipe saves as JSON.

pipelineforge.title: PipelineForge
pipelineforge.description: A deal list with a live forecast. Add deals with a value, win probability and stage, filter by stage or search by name, and the bar on top keeps pipeline total, weighted forecast and won value current. Arrow keys move the selection; save or reopen the list as JSON.

nib.title: Nib
nib.description: A typeface drawn by one pen. Every letter is a bare skeleton of lines and arcs, and a single nib swept along it makes the shape — drag the pen pad to turn and widen the nib, adjust slant, x-height, bowls and wobble, tap any glyph to see its construction, and export the result as a real TrueType font you can install.

parapet.title: Parapet
parapet.description: A security-header audit that runs in the page. Paste the response headers from curl or DevTools and it grades them out of 100, lists each finding with a one-tap fix, maps every Content-Security-Policy source by how open it is, and exports the hardened set as nginx, Apache, Caddy or Express config.

keycuts.title: Keycuts
keycuts.description: A keyboard shortcut trainer. Pick VS Code, Gmail, Chrome or macOS, read the action and press its combo on your keyboard or the on-screen keys; misses go into a needs-work pile, a learn mode shows flip cards, and you can add your own shortcuts and save progress as JSON.

rename-studio.title: Rename Studio
rename-studio.description: Plan a batch rename before touching any files. Build a naming pattern from date, client, project, name and counter tokens, watch the new name for every file update as you type with duplicates flagged, then copy the names or download the plan as text.

fourier-epicycles-studio.title: Fourier Epicycles Studio
fourier-epicycles-studio.description: Draw any closed shape and watch it redrawn by a chain of rotating circles. The app takes the discrete Fourier transform of your path and traces it back with epicycles; slide the number of terms up and down to see the reconstruction sharpen or blur, change the speed, and save or reload a drawing as JSON.

breathe.title: Breathe
breathe.description: A guided breathing pacer. Pick box, 4-7-8, coherent or deep-slow breathing and a session length and follow the circle as it grows and shrinks, or switch to hold mode and press the circle to breathe in and let go to breathe out; sessions are logged on the device and can be saved as JSON.

celestialtrace.title: CelestialTrace
celestialtrace.description: A gravitational N-body sandbox. Drag on the canvas to launch a planet with a velocity vector and watch it orbit, slingshot or merge with the other bodies, tune the gravitational constant, trail length and collision mode, and save or reload a system as JSON.

umbra.title: Umbra
umbra.description: A sun and shadow planner for a 50 m site. Place buildings and trees, set a date, city or latitude and longitude and the map rotation, then scrub or play through the day to watch the shadows move; a colour map shows how many hours of direct sun each patch of ground gets, and scenes save and reopen as JSON.

ebru.title: Ebru
ebru.description: A paper-marbling bath. Tap to float ink drops that push the earlier ones aside, then drag a rake, comb, wave or swirl through them; every gesture is an exact closed-form deformation, so pictures replay perfectly from the saved gesture list, and you can start from stone, gelgit, nonpareil, bouquet, peacock or vortex presets, switch palettes and paper, undo, and export a 2000-px PNG.

nash.title: Nash
nash.description: Hex against a computer opponent you can watch think. You connect left to right, Nash connects top to bottom, and while it searches the board glows with where its Monte-Carlo tree search is spending attention; pick a 7, 9 or 11 board, quick to deep thinking time, ask for a hint, undo, and save or open games as JSON.

belfry.title: Belfry
belfry.description: A change-ringing studio for six synthesised bells. Tap a bell to hear it, play a score row by row at a chosen strikes-per-minute, follow one bell’s path through the diagram, edit which neighbouring positions swap on each row or build your own method and return it to rounds, choose a bronze or glass voice, and save the score as JSON or export the performance as a WAV.

drift-soundscape.title: Drift
drift-soundscape.description: An ambient soundscape mixer. Rain, ocean, wind, fire and birdsong are synthesised live from filtered noise and scheduled chirps and crackles, with no recordings; blend them with sliders, start from presets like Rainy Night or Forest Dawn, set a sleep timer, and save or open a mix as JSON.

dropzone.title: Dropzone
dropzone.description: A Galton board. Tap along the top to drop a ball, or release ten, a hundred or a steady rain, and watch them bounce through 5 to 12 rows of pegs into bins while a histogram fills in against the ideal binomial curve; live stats show the count, mean, spread and bell match, and results save and reopen as JSON.

lathe.title: Lathe
lathe.description: A pottery wheel in one file. The pot is a solid of revolution rendered in software on a 2D canvas; drag on the wall to pull it out or push it in, smooth out lumps, set brush width and height, start from vase, bowl, bottle, cup or plate presets, pick glazes and camera tilt, then save the pot as JSON or export a watertight OBJ with real wall thickness for 3D printing.

paper-cinema.title: Paper Cinema
paper-cinema.description: A barrier-grid animation studio. Draw four 40×24 pixel frames with ink and erase tools, play them back or scrub a virtual shutter across the interlaced plate, and export a print kit with the plate and the slitted shutter at actual size so the animation works on paper; films save and reopen as JSON.

passphrase-forge.title: Passphrase Forge
passphrase-forge.description: A password and passphrase generator. Forge a memorable multi-word passphrase or a random character password from the browser’s secure random source, tune words, separators, capitals, length and character sets, and see the entropy in bits with estimated offline and online crack times; recent results are kept for copying and settings save as JSON.

swiftread.title: Swiftread
swiftread.description: An RSVP speed reader. Paste any text and press play to see it one word (or two or three) at a time with the focal letter highlighted so your eyes stay still; set the words per minute live, skip or jump along the progress bar, and save or open your text and position as JSON.

trill.title: Trill
trill.description: A modem made of birdsong. Type a message and it plays as a short melody of 32 pure tones that another phone (or the same one) decodes from its microphone, with a live waterfall of what the decoder hears; a self-test routes a message through simulated room noise so you can watch it lock on, and drafts and the inbox save as JSON.
